title: Progress
description: Work under way, as a bar: how far it is (`current` of `total`), what it is, and whether its end is known at all (`indeterminate`). The value said as a share or as a count; the bar in a state's tone.

showValue.description: Whether the value is said beside the bar.

valueFormat.description: How the value is said: the share it makes, or `current / total`.

indeterminate.description: Under way, its end not known: the bar runs without a value.

type.description: The tone the bar is drawn in.
